title: AeroDesign — the avionics
spec: Wiring hub · 5 V 15 A power, twice · 4 → 6 layers · ~30 people
summary: The plane as a body: a wiring hub for a brain, a power board for a heart, and a rat's nest to untangle. Three seasons, two power boards, one shoot-through, and a 5th-place plane that flew anyway.
